Name: Bun's Datable Jodi Portraits
Author: Buncisoup
Description:
Replaces Jodi's portrait from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7721]Datable jodi[/url] mod to fit with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16868]Bun's NPC Portrait[/url].
I only add/switch Jodi's portrait into the new sprites, all the content stays within the base mod.

[size=4][b]Installation
[/b][/size][spoiler]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7721]Datable Jodi﻿[/url]﻿ and its dependencies
[*]Extract '[i]Bun's Datable Jodi Portrait[/i]' into '[i]Mods[/i]' folder
There will be two folder :
 -  '[i]Bun's Datable Jodi Portrait[/i]' for manifest file, and
﻿ -  '[i][CP] Datable Jodi[/i]' folder that will replace Datable Jodi's original portraits with Bun's portraits
Let the files overwrite
[*]Run the game by running the SMAPI.exe
[/list]
If you find a bug, please let me know ([url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi log[/url] would be helpful)

To uninstall this mod, simply remove [i]'[/i][i]Bun's Datable Jodi Portrait[/i]' folder from [i]'Mods'[/i] folder.
Reinstall Datable Jodi to get the original portraits fom the mod.
[/spoiler]
[size=4][b]How to choose the portrait[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Download whichever option you'd like
[*]If you change your mind and would like to install the other option, simply reinstall the mod.
[*]If you use [b]blonde [/b]option but the character sprite sometimes shows [b]pink[/b], try reinstalling Datable jodi.
[*]It's a given, but use the same [b]JodiHair-color[/b] configuration on Bun's NPC Portraits so Jodi has a consistent hair color.
[/list][/spoiler]

[i]Thank you Moralle for making Datable Jodi as the base mod and letting me do this[/i]
